'''Chapter 1047''' is titled "The Sky Over the Capital".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: The [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]] and [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] in his dragon form on a beach.

==Short Summary==
[[Yamato]] urges [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] to make flame clouds. Despite the latter being unable to do so, he still tries to stop [[Onigashima]], [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s battle with [[Kaidou]] continues to rage on the roof. Kaidou states that [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] was not a [[Devil Fruit]] user, and that [[Haki]] conquers everything. In the dome, the samurai re-affirm their support for Luffy, and [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]] tries to attack [[Kouzuki Hiyori|Hiyori]]. Luffy creates a giant fist to finish the battle and instructs Momo to move Onigashima before his next attack.

==Long Summary==
[[Yamato]] encourages [[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] to make large flame clouds, but he claims it’s easier said than done. He then thinks back to the day his home was destroyed, when his mother, [[Kouzuki Toki]], told him to flee to the future. He admitted he felt he couldn’t unless she and his sister accompanied him, but [[Kin'emon|Kin’emon]] reminds him that in the Land of [[Wano Country|Wano]], when one suffers a great failure, they forfeit their life, and therefore, he can’t question the resolve of his mother. He retorts that he is just a kid, but Kin’emon says that with [[Kouzuki Oden|Oden]] gone, he isn’t just his heir anymore. With tears in his eyes too, Kin’emon begged for Momonosuke to give him another chance to fight rather than die a shameful death by fire. Though he was reluctant, Momonosuke agreed to leave his mother behind with his followers. In the present, Momonosuke regains his own conviction and declares that he would never be able to face his mother if he gave up now, and continues to try and stop the island.

On the roof, [[Kaidou]] remarks on how [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] was able to actually grab lighting, as Luffy uses a new move called '''[[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 5 Techniques#Situational Techniques|Gomu Gomu no Kaminari]]''' and hurls the lightning bolt at Kaidou. Kaidou, however, sidesteps it and smacks him with [[Hassaikai]], sending him flying off only for Luffy to grab another lightning bolt and swing around and back at Kaidou with an inflated leg. Before he can use another move though, Kaidou dodges and strikes Luffy on the head, where he declares that in the end, a strong [[Devil Fruit]] power isn’t enough to conquer the seas, revealing that [[Gol D. Roger]] himself had no Devil Fruit power yet he was still able to become the Pirate King. Luffy gets propelled down to the ground, which bounces him back up, and as he tries to defend himself, Kaidou yells that to conquer the seas, the one thing that truly matters is [[Haki]]. 

He then hits him with '''[[Hassaikai#Techniques|Daiitoku Raimei Hakke]]''' which injures Luffy, but he still grabs Kaidou and starts dragging him up with him to the sky, only for Kaidou to try and shake him loose while changing into his full [[Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu|dragon form]] to blast him with '''Tatsumaki Kaifu''', acknowledging that even with his awakened power, he’s still weak to slashing attacks. While that was going on, the people of the [[Flower Capital]] watch their sky lanterns float up into the air with the hope that their wishes will reach the heavens, as they know they will return to being slaves again. Kaidou then blasts Luffy with '''Bolo Breath''' to get him to let go while demanding he gets back down.

In the castle, while the fire continues to rage on in some parts of the island, [[Hyougoro]] is informed that the island is falling, which he says is because Kaidou is at the end of his rope. He asks everyone what outcome they would prefer: Luffy defeating Kaidou and causing the island to fall and potentially kill everyone, or Kaidou to win and extend everyone’s lives by only a little while. The samurai immediately say they’re okay with dying as long as the innocent continue to live, and they cheer for Luffy to fight without worrying about them. Some [[Beasts Pirates]] retort that they may all die, but Hyougoro doesn’t mind.

In the basement, [[Usopp]] and [[Hamlet]] are running for their lives from the raging fire, only to get swept up in [[Raizo]]'s water, to their relief. On the Treasure Repository floor, [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]] has managed to get the [[Seastone]] nail out of his body, allowing him to [[Hebi Hebi no Mi, Model: Yamata no Orochi|transform]] while still on fire, though he is reduced to one head left. Still, he proclaims that if he dies, he will spite Oden by taking [[Kouzuki Hiyori|Hiyori]] with him.

Back on the roof, Luffy tells Momonosuke to get the island out of the way, as he reveals he has inflated his hand to such an enormous size that it rivaled [[Onigashima]] itself and coated in Haki, fully planning to unleash it on Kaidou.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Kouzuki Momonosuke|Momonosuke]] is having difficulty making the flame clouds necessary to levitate [[Onigashima]].
**He recalls his last interaction with his [[Kouzuki Toki|mother]].
*The fight between [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Kaidou]] continues.
**Kaidou states to Luffy that [[Gol D. Roger|Roger]] was not a [[Devil Fruit]] user.
***He also states to Luffy that Devil Fruit abilities cannot conquer the world, only [[Haki]] could as it reigns supreme.
**Kaidou figures out that even with his [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 5 Techniques|new form]], Luffy is still vulnerable to cutting attacks.
*The [[Fire Festival]] continues as the participants release the paper lanterns.
*The samurai inside the [[Skull Dome]] realize what would happen if Luffy beat Kaidou, but decide to not worry about the consequences knowing that [[Wano Country]] would be free if Luffy won.
*The vibrations managed to remove the [[Seastone]] nail from [[Kurozumi Orochi|Orochi]], which allowed him to transform into his [[Hebi Hebi no Mi, Model: Yamata no Orochi|beast form]].
**Only one of his heads remains.
**Orochi attempts to attack [[Kouzuki Hiyori|Hiyori]] to take her down with him.
*Luffy prepares to end the battle by make his fist the size of an island preparing to launch a massive attack against Kaidou that would punch through Onigashima unless Momonosuke moves it out of the way first.
**Luffy shouts to Momonosuke his encouragement that he can complete his mission.
